title: Extend note-guards past its spec after independent review
context: An independent review of mitosis/note-guards at 920e1ca found the diff defect-free against its item, but found two gaps in what the item asked for. The float goldens also depend on lib/data/media/blob_prefix.dart (tilt hash), test/design/widgets/widget_harness.dart and test/flutter_test_config.dart (font loading), none of which is in goldens.yml's paths list. And the GC guard's pattern \.collectGarbage\( misses a tear-off such as Future.microtask(store.collectGarbage) and an unqualified call. Both were verified in the session: the imports exist, and the stronger pattern (?U+003C!FutureU+003Cint>\s)\bcollectGarbage\b matches only journal_data_controller.dart and filesystem_media_store.dart in lib today.
options: ship note-guards exactly as specified and leave the gaps

add a follow-up commit on mitosis/note-guards after its mitosis gate: three more goldens.yml paths plus the matching workflow-test globs, and the stronger GC pattern; amend the fix-wave spec's F13 and F14 text in the same PR
outcome: Add the follow-up commit after the mitosis gate for note-guards has run, so the gate's revert probe is not disturbed. The items file stays as it ran; the spec document and the PR body record the extension.
